risks: We derive a significant portion of our revenue from operations from our top 10 customers with which we do not have any firm commitments.
The loss of any one or more of our major customers would have a material adverse effect on our business, cash flows, results of operations and financial condition.
Our business operations are highly dependent on our top customers, which exposes us to a high risk of customer concentration.
While we have not had any instances of loss of our top 10 customers by revenue in the last three Fiscals, there can be no assurance that it will not happen in the future.

Further, if our clients choose to insource logistics or manpower functions, reduce outsourcing, or face financial or regulatory challenges, it may lead to loss of business, under - utilisation of our resources, delayed payments and adverse impact on our cash flows, financial condition and results of operations.
Our business is also characterized by significant customer concentration, with our top 10 customers contributing over 80% of our revenue in recent periods.
Any reduction in business from these key customers may materially and adversely affect our revenue and profitability.
We are exposed to risks relating to loss, damage, contamination or delay in transportation of diagnostic samples, which could result in client claims, financial liabilities and reputational harm.

business_ops.seasonality: Revenue is seasonal, skewed to H2 (October-March) over H1 (April-September): FY26 42.09%/57.91%, FY25 38.18%/61.82%, FY24 40.07%/59.93% (H1/H2 split). Attributed to increased preventive health check-ups, corporate wellness programs, seasonal disease patterns, institutional client budget-utilization cycles and festive-season fluctuations in routine testing. Since employee compensation, vehicle expenses and administrative overheads are largely fixed, any H1 revenue shortfall or weaker-than-expected H2 growth can adversely affect profitability and cash flows.
business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Service-based company with no significant plant & machinery requirement and no specific raw-material requirement. Subsidiary Credent Healthcare Private Limited owns limited diagnostic equipment (Cardiovit CS 20 treadmill, Versana Balance V2 USG, LG Wireless X-Ray Detector) used in service delivery. Technology backward-integration via wholly owned subsidiary Alltrak Technologies Private Limited's 'LogiTrak' SaaS platform (real-time sample tracking, GPS rider tracking, workforce management, geo-fencing) used internally for own operations. No technical or financial collaboration agreements or joint ventures entered into with third parties.

overview.business_model: Earns service revenue from B2B service-level contracts with diagnostic laboratories, hospitals, IVD/pharma companies and corporates for healthcare logistics (temperature-controlled sample transport), phlebotomy/lab-technician staffing, home sample collection, corporate wellness programs (C3 Wellness), and courier aggregation (C3 Post); scope was recently expanded through three subsidiary acquisitions (Credent Healthcare, Credent Team, Alltrak Technologies).

overview.one_liner: Healthcare logistics and workforce solutions provider offering home sample collection, phlebotomy staffing, cold-chain transportation, and technology-enabled support to diagnostic labs, hospitals, and healthcare companies across India.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We provide comprehensive operational and logistics services to diagnostic laboratories, In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) companies, pharmaceutical companies, clinics, and other healthcare enterprises through end-to-end solutions.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: Our operations are headquartered in Ashok Vihar, Delhi, and we operate through 2 warehouses and 4 branch offices across India, including in Mumbai, Pune, Chennai, and Varanasi.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We provide Business to Business (B2B) Healthcare logistics services that involve the transportation of diagnostic samples from collection points to laboratories and between healthcare facilities & we also provide services to IVD companies for reagent movement from their C&F to labs.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: In addition, we provide deployment of requisite healthcare manpower, operational coordination, logistics management, and on-ground execution of diagnostic and sample collection activities at designated locations.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We operate a smart courier aggregation platform, C3 Post, which provides pan-India pin-code coverage for bulk shipping.

internal_operational.risk: We derive a significant portion of our revenue from operations from our top 10 customers with which we do not have any firm commitments.
The loss of any one or more of our major customers would have a material adverse effect on our business, cash flows, results of operations and financial condition.

strategy_growth.risk: Our business is highly dependent on the availability and performance of a large, skilled and geographically dispersed workforce, and our inability to effectively manage, train and retain such personnel could adversely affect our operations.
We may face challenges in recruiting and retaining personnel with the required technical skills and field experience, particularly as we scale our operations or expand into new geographies.
Monitoring a geographically dispersed workforce presents operational challenges, and we may not be able to detect or prevent all such incidents in a timely manner.

verdict.our_read: Credent Connect N Care is a healthcare logistics and paramedical-workforce outsourcing provider (cold-chain sample transport, phlebotomy staffing, home sample collection) to diagnostic labs and hospitals, whose FY26 revenue nearly tripled to ₹21,416.18 lakhs largely on the consolidation of three subsidiaries acquired within the prior 16 months (Credent Healthcare, Credent Team, Alltrak Technologies), setting up the central tension of whether this growth is organic and sustainable versus a one-time consolidation effect, against a backdrop of promoter dilution from 87.52% to 63.66% and a Nil-cost 50:1 bonus issue just before the IPO.

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Service-based company with no significant plant & machinery requirement and no specific raw-material requirement. Subsidiary Credent Healthcare Private Limited owns limited diagnostic equipment (Cardiovit CS 20 treadmill, Versana Balance V2 USG, LG Wireless X-Ray Detector) used in service delivery. Technology backward-integration via wholly owned subsidiary Alltrak Technologies Private Limited's 'LogiTrak' SaaS platform (real-time sample tracking, GPS rider tracking, workforce management, geo-fencing) used internally for own operations. No technical or financial collaboration agreements or joint ventures entered into with third parties.

demand_drivers.title: Seasonality (RHP report)
demand_drivers.body: Revenue is seasonal, skewed to H2 (October-March) over H1 (April-September): FY26 42.09%/57.91%, FY25 38.18%/61.82%, FY24 40.07%/59.93% (H1/H2 split). Attributed to increased preventive health check-ups, corporate wellness programs, seasonal disease patterns, institutional client budget-utilization cycles and festive-season fluctuations in routine testing. Since employee compensation, vehicle expenses and administrative overheads are largely fixed, any H1 revenue shortfall or weaker-than-expected H2 growth can adversely affect profitability and cash flows.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- We derive a significant portion of our revenue from operations from our top 10 customers with which we do not have any firm commitments.
- The loss of any one or more of our major customers would have a material adverse effect on our business, cash flows, results of operations and financial condition.
- Our business operations are highly dependent on our top customers, which exposes us to a high risk of customer concentration.
- While we have not had any instances of loss of our top 10 customers by revenue in the last three Fiscals, there can be no assurance that it will not happen in the future.
- Further, if our clients choose to insource logistics or manpower functions, reduce outsourcing, or face financial or regulatory challenges, it may lead to loss of business, under - utilisation of our resources, delayed payments and adverse impact on our cash flows, financial condition and results of operations.
- Our business is also characterized by significant customer concentration, with our top 10 customers contributing over 80% of our revenue in recent periods.
- Any reduction in business from these key customers may materially and adversely affect our revenue and profitability.
- We are exposed to risks relating to loss, damage, contamination or delay in transportation of diagnostic samples, which could result in client claims, financial liabilities and reputational harm.
